superseded_attempts.reason: The first launch of this group died on a wrapper defect: the arms directory path was indexed as a mapping, so run_group raised TypeError before a probe process existed. The directory was withdrawn by rename and the group was rebuilt from scratch; it is kept because deleting it would make the group look like a first try that worked.

superseded_notes: No process and no group was discarded: all fourteen scheduled processes ran once and are archived. The withdrawn setup attempt ran zero processes and holds no timing.
The 40000 entity pair is archived and reported apart. It is a diagnostic of the lever's reach at stress scale, never a gate row, and it is not spliced into any capacity ladder.

preregistration.order: per pair the arm order alternates (baseline-first, candidate-first, baseline-first); each process runs one gate cell

gate.submit_improvement: submit median improves by at least 10 percent at both (1800, render-only) and (2600, render-only)
gate.cycle_non_regression: cycle median and cycle p99 median regress by at most 5 percent in every gate cell
gate.repeatability: per cell and arm, (max-min)/median of the process medians is at most 15 percent for submit and cycle
gate.value_identity: every process reports 255,204,51,255 with draws and in-view centers equal to the entity count, and both arms agree
gate.stop: an invalid process stops the group; no retry, no replacement, no extra samples

process_identity.pass_rule: wall FPS>=240 and cycle p99<=4.166667ms; duration runs additionally every full 1-second bin >=240 completed frames
process_identity.stop: invalid process stops; budget failures are retained capacity points, never replaced or extended
